column1: # kind self: base diffed against itself. history: a real commit against its first parent.
# controlled: head is an edit applied to base in a scratch clone and committed with a fixed identity and date.
# label: what the construction claims; run.py checks it against the Go toolchain on both revisions.
#   compile_break      base builds and vets, head does not
#   behavior_break     both build and vet, base tests pass, head tests fail
#   compiles           both build and vet (no claim about behavior)
#   rebind_compiles    both build and vet, an identifier of a moved declaration binds another package
#   -                  no constructed claim (self diffs and real history)
